'''Hélène Bouchiat''' ({{IPA|fr|elɛn buʃja}}; born 1958) is a French [[Condensed matter physics|condensed matter physicist]] specializing in [[mesoscopic physics]] and [[nanoscience]].{{r|cv}} She is a [[Academic ranks in France|director of research]] in the [[French National Centre for Scientific Research]] (CNRS), associated with the [[Laboratoire de Physique des Solides]] at [[Paris-Sud University]].{{r|acad}} Topics in her research include [[supercurrent]]s, [[persistent current]]s, [[graphene]], [[carbon nanotube]]s, and [[Topological insulator#Bismuth-based topological insulators|bismuth-based topological insulators]].

==Early life and education==
Bouchiat is the daughter of physicists [[Marie-Anne Bouchiat|Marie-Anne]] (née Guiochon) and [[Claude Bouchiat]].<ref name=x1953>{{cite web |url=https://1953.polytechnique.org/Itineraires/Bouchiat.html |title=Claude Bouchiat |last= |first= |date= |website=1953.polytechnique.org |publisher= |access-date=2023-12-11 |quote=}}</ref>

She was a student at the [[École normale supérieure]].{{r|cv|annuaire}} Her 1986 doctoral dissertation, ''Transition verre de spin : comportement critique et bruit magnétique'', was supervised by {{ill|Philippe Monod|fr|Philippe Monod (physicien)}} at Paris-Sud University.{{r|diss}}

==Career==
With the exception of an 18-month postdoctoral research visit at [[Bell Labs]], Bouchiat has spent her entire career with the CNRS.{{r|cv}}

==Honors and awards==
Bouchiat is a member of the [[French Academy of Sciences]], elected in 2010.{{r|acad}} The academy also gave her their Anatole and Suzanne Abragam Prize in 1994, and their {{ill|Jaffé Prize|fr|Prix Jaffé}} in 1998. She won the [[CNRS gold medal|CNRS bronze and silver medals]] in 1987 and 2007 respectively.{{r|cv}}

==Personal life==
Bouchiat has a brother, [[Vincent Bouchiat]] who is also a physicist.<ref name=phdVincent>
{{cite thesis |type=PhD |last=Bouchiat |first=Vincent |date=1997 |title=Quantum fluctuations of the charge in single electron and single Cooper pair devices |publisher=[[Université Pierre et Marie Curie]]  |oclc=1040947759 |url=https://theses.fr/1997PA066241 |quote=Enfin, j'ai une pensée toute particulière pour mes parents, Geneviève, Hélène, et Behnaz pour leur soutien constant durant toutes ces années.}}
</ref>
